entries.description: Every Let's Encrypt host renewal handed the panel certificate to exim, which keeps proftpd from starting under the AppArmor profile of Ubuntu 26.04; the files get root:mail again, as the installer writes them

A Debian box received no automatic updates at all: the installer never installed unattended-upgrades, and only Ubuntu's image carries it. Debian's own configuration comes with it, security updates and point releases, switched on even where the Debian installer stored it as off
unattended-upgrades patched the distribution's origins only, so Sury PHP got no update without a hand step; the Sury origin is added where the repo is
